source.title: P12-A Speaker Conflict Sandbox Base
source.notes: Separate baseline for conflict detection; do not modify main P12 QA Workspace.

segments.text: Good morning! Are you ready for our English practice?
segments.meaning: Selamat pagi! Apakah kamu siap untuk latihan bahasa Inggris kita?

segments.text: Almost. I need to review five new words first.
segments.meaning: Hampir. Aku perlu mengulang lima kata baru terlebih dahulu.

segments.text: Could you say that again, please?
segments.meaning: Bisakah kamu mengatakannya sekali lagi, tolong?

segments.text: I need to review five new words.
segments.meaning: Aku perlu mengulang lima kata baru.

segments.text: What does the word confident mean?
It means feeling sure about yourself.
segments.meaning: Artinya merasa yakin terhadap dirimu sendiri.

segments.text: Could you give us an example?
segments.meaning: Bisakah kamu memberikan contoh kepada kami?

segments.text: I feel confident when I practise every day.
segments.meaning: Aku merasa percaya diri ketika berlatih setiap hari.

segments.text: Could you say that again, please?
segments.meaning: Bisakah kamu mengatakannya sekali lagi, tolong?

segments.text: Shall we practise the dialogue once more?
segments.meaning: Bagaimana kalau kita berlatih dialognya sekali lagi?

segments.text: Yes, and let us speak a little more slowly.
segments.meaning: Ya, dan mari kita berbicara sedikit lebih pelan.

segments.text: That sounds good. We can practise again tomorrow.
segments.meaning: Kedengarannya bagus. Kita bisa berlatih lagi besok.

segments.text: Thank you, everyone. See you tomorrow!
segments.meaning: Terima kasih, semuanya. Sampai jumpa besok!
